name: English
description: Unload idle Firefox tabs with a recent working set, site exclusions and manual protection.

messages.Unsaved input may be lost. Protect edito: Unsaved input may be lost. Protect editors and forms before unloading.
messages.Keep this many recently used tabs loaded: Keep this many recently used tabs loaded. Protected tabs may increase the total.
messages.Tabs outside the working set can sleep a: Tabs outside the working set can sleep after this time. Background reloads do not count as visits.
messages.Delay sleep after a quick return: Delay sleep after a quick return
messages.Returning within two minutes of a FireUp: Returning within two minutes of a FireUp unload delays the next automatic sleep. With a 10-minute timer, the delay grows to 20, 40, 80 and 120 minutes. Manual unloading remains available.
messages.A domain also protects its subdomains. U: A domain also protects its subdomains. Use chatgpt.com to protect all its tabs. Do not include paths, ports or wildcards.
messages.Uses the browser interface language. Oth: Uses the browser interface language. Other languages fall back to English.
messages.Export includes applied settings and exc: Export includes applied settings and excluded domains. Per-tab protection and open-tab URLs are not included.
messages.Applying this file replaces all current: Applying this file replaces all current settings, including whether automatic sleep is enabled.
messages.FireUp does not read page contents or de: FireUp does not read page contents or detect every form or silent playback. Protect tabs or sites with unsaved input. Active, pinned, audible tabs and browser-reported calls are skipped. Private tabs are excluded.
messages.Alt+Shift+U unloads unprotected backgrou: Alt+Shift+U unloads unprotected background tabs in all windows. FireUp does not close tabs or terminate processes.
messages.Quick return · sleep in about {minutes}: Quick return · sleep in about {minutes} min
messages.Ready to sleep · waiting for queue: Ready to sleep · waiting for queue
Search and filters only change the list. Hidden tabs in the selected scope are included. Protected tabs stay loaded.
messages.Manual unloading includes recent tabs. P: Manual unloading includes recent tabs. Protected tabs stay loaded.
messages.No matches. Change your search or filter: No matches. Change your search or filter.
messages.Automatic sleep paused. Manual unloading: Automatic sleep paused. Manual unloading is available.
messages.Queue stopped. Tabs already unloaded rem: Queue stopped. Tabs already unloaded remain asleep.
messages.The browser received fireup-settings.jso: The browser received fireup-settings.json for saving.
messages.Automatic sleep: {enabled}. Working set:: Automatic sleep: {enabled}. Working set: {keep}. Timer: {idle} min. Quick-return delay: {anti}. Theme: {theme}. Language: {language}. Sites: {sites}.
messages.File validated. Review the settings befo: File validated. Review the settings before applying.
messages.Enter a domain without a path or port, s: Enter a domain without a path or port, such as chatgpt.com.
messages.Automatic sleep and quick-return delay m: Automatic sleep and quick-return delay must be true or false.
messages.The working set must be between 1 and 10: The working set must be between 1 and 100.
messages.The timer must be between 1 and 1440 min: The timer must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
messages.The settings file must be no larger than: The settings file must be no larger than 256 KB.
messages.Could not read JSON. Choose a FireUp set: Could not read JSON. Choose a FireUp settings export.
messages.Unload background tabs in this window: Unload background tabs in this window
messages.Unload unprotected background tabs in al: Unload unprotected background tabs in all windows
No tabs can be unloaded in this scope.
